Software Engineer, PHP

Summary:
Software Engineer PHP working on server-side development and database management for innovative digital solutions company. Collaborating with front-end team in an Agile environment.
Software Engineer PHP building and maintaining server-side web applications.
Role description:
• Writing clean, reusable, and secure PHP code.
• Designing and optimizing MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL databases.
• Building and consuming RESTful APIs for third-party and frontend services.
• Troubleshooting performance bottlenecks and fixing application bugs.
• Working alongside front-end developers, designers, and project managers in an Agile environment.
Role requirements:
• Advanced knowledge of Object-Oriented PHP.
• Proficiency in frameworks like Laravel, Symfony, CodeIgniter, or CakePHP.
• Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery.
• Understanding of Git version control and dependency managers like Composer.
• Experience with WordPress, WooCommerce, or Magento.
Tech stack:
JavaScript, jQuery, Laravel, Magento, MariaDB, MySQL, PHP, Postgres, Symfony, WordPress
